learner_facing_text: Planned Field Skill: Ground-Level Soft Goods Handling.
notes: Ground handling/care only; no fly-system, overhead attachment, FR approval or installation authority. Planned HR06 research precursor retained for provenance; canonical live learner identity is C-FLD-SOFT at courses/field-skill-ground-level-soft-goods.html.

learner_facing_text: Soft goods should be protected from unnecessary dragging, contamination and crushing, with the actual fabric/item care and storage method controlled by the responsible department/manufacturer.
notes: No universal fold/storage method is asserted. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-SOFT-GOODS to canonical live course C-FLD-SOFT on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-ground-level-soft-goods.html.

learner_facing_text: A beginner may recognize that flame-retardancy documentation matters, but may not self-certify fabric, improvise flame testing/treatment, or decide code/AHJ acceptance.
notes: Local fire/building authority and controlling documentation govern acceptance. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-SOFT-GOODS to canonical live course C-FLD-SOFT on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-ground-level-soft-goods.html.

Recognition, staging and lead-directed support only; exact system/configuration remains manufacturer/lead controlled. Planned HR06 research precursor retained for provenance; canonical live learner identity is C-FLD-PD at courses/field-skill-pipe-and-drape-support.html.

learner_facing_text: Pipe-and-drape systems share recognizable component families, but dimensions, connections, allowable spans/heights and stabilization details are manufacturer/system specific.
notes: No universal assembly sequence, base weight or ballast rule is created. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-PIPE-DRAPE to canonical live course C-FLD-PD on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-pipe-and-drape-support.html.

learner_facing_text: A learner may support the assigned system under direction but does not independently accept stability, ballast, public-route, outdoor/wind or code compliance.
notes: Final acceptance remains with manufacturer/lead/venue/AHJ or other responsible authority. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-PIPE-DRAPE to canonical live course C-FLD-PD on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-pipe-and-drape-support.html.

learner_facing_text: Planned Field Skill: Riser / Deck / Portable-Platform Component Support.
notes: Recognition/movement/staging only; structural assembly/acceptance intentionally excluded. Planned HR06 research precursor retained for provenance; canonical live learner identity is C-FLD-DECK at courses/field-skill-riser-deck-component-support.html.

learner_facing_text: Portable stage/riser systems vary materially in supports, locks, bracing, heights, deck sizes, stairs, rails and allowable configurations, so one system's method must not be generalized to another.
notes: Manufacturer-family evidence establishes variation only; no assembly steps are taught. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-RISER-DECK-SUPPORT to canonical live course C-FLD-DECK on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-riser-deck-component-support.html.

learner_facing_text: General learner support does not include independent structural assembly, leveling, locking/bracing acceptance, guardrail/stair/ramp installation, load-capacity decisions, structural signoff or public-occupancy acceptance.
notes: Exact manufacturer system and responsible structural/venue authority control those decisions. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-RISER-DECK-SUPPORT to canonical live course C-FLD-DECK on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-riser-deck-component-support.html.

learner_facing_text: Planned Field Skill: Basic Stagehand Tool Recognition, Handoff and Storage.
notes: Ordinary non-powered tool readiness only; no hazardous/powered/cutting/electrical-testing/rigging procedure. Planned HR06 research precursor retained for provenance; canonical live learner identity is C-FLD-TOOLS at courses/field-skill-basic-stagehand-tool-handling.html.

learner_facing_text: Basic stagehand tool expectations vary by local, employer, venue, department and assignment; Crew Blueprint should teach call-specific readiness rather than one universal national toolkit.
notes: Supported by multiple IATSE local tool/readiness pages. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-TOOLS-READINESS to canonical live course C-FLD-TOOLS on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-basic-stagehand-tool-handling.html.

learner_facing_text: Recognizing or carrying a tool does not authorize every task associated with it; unfamiliar, powered, cutting, electrical-testing, rigging, overhead or other specialist work requires separate assignment/training/authority.
notes: No operational technique for hazardous tools is included. Promoted from planned HR06 identity C-FLD-TOOLS-READINESS to canonical live course C-FLD-TOOLS on 2026-09-10; learner route courses/field-skill-basic-stagehand-tool-handling.html.
